lineage_rule: Each stage retains its accepted disposition and evidentiary role. Later engineering or exploration does not retroactively change an earlier scientific result.

experiments.lesson_carried_forward: Target movement must be selective against nuisance movement, and refusal/observability heterogeneity cannot be hidden.
Scale and custody do not rescue identification when matched coverage and nuisance stability fail. Offline qualification remains engineering evidence only.

forbidden_collapses: Experiment 1 target movement is not a supported Experiment 1 result.
Experiment 2 post-confirmatory archaeology is not a replacement confirmatory result.
Experiment 3 synthetic validation is not real-model evidence.
Experiment 3 local Qwen2.5 evidence is not Claude/Gemini evidence.
Provider path qualification is not scientific execution.
